# Flat Action Cadence

Find runs of at least three complete subject-first action clauses presented as equally detached beats. Changed actors, objects and verbs can preserve the same mechanical rhythm.

- Require complete clauses with their own subjects. A bare fragment stack or subject inherited from an earlier sentence belongs to fragment stacking.
- Judge the repeated presentation of the sequence. Distinct actions or concrete plot information do not by themselves supply varied emphasis. Chronological order alone establishes no useful-function exemption.
- Preserve equal short beats when their order or separate emphasis serves a recoverable procedure, event reconstruction, parallel comparison or deliberate pacing effect. A fiction genre, a technical topic or the word footage alone establishes none of those functions.
- Read the complete supplied context, including adjacent paragraphs continuing the sequence. Separate records or unrelated sections establish separate sequences.

# Fragment Stacking

Find clipped sequences that break ordinary explanatory or narrative prose into promotional or dramatic fragment beats. Apply grammar and function, including unfamiliar wording.

- Require three instances of an ordinary multiword opening, distinctive recurring subject or internal frame. An internal modal-plus-still construction can repeat despite changed subjects and verbs.

- Connect adjacent paragraphs when the construction continues. Separate sections, records or dialogue turns establish separate sequences unless explicitly connected.

# Sentence Frame Repetition

Find mechanically repeated lexical sentence frames, including unfamiliar wording and internal phrases. Read the complete connected sequence.

- Require three instances of an ordinary multiword opening, distinctive recurring subject or internal frame. An internal modal-plus-still construction can repeat despite changed subjects and verbs.
- Two adjacent sentences qualify only when both repeat the same explicit answer, fix, goal, lesson, point, result, trick or equivalent takeaway wrapper. Other frames require three.
- Count lexical framing, rather than merely the grammatical shape subject-verb-object. A common pronoun, necessary name or grammatical word alone establishes no defect.
- Then judge what the recurring form contributes. Preserve parallel comparisons, useful progression, independently meaningful instruction organization and deliberate refrain. Useful facts elsewhere leave an independently mechanical wrapper eligible.
- Connect adjacent paragraphs when the construction continues. Separate sections, records or dialogue turns establish separate sequences unless explicitly connected.
- Connector-only recurrence belongs to the transition check; a weak repeated terminal predicate belongs to the ending check. Identify a separately defective opening or internal frame on its own merits.
- Preserve wording reproduced for examination or documentation. Judge adopted quotations and ordinary dialogue normally.

Check recurring WORDING before judging style. Different subjects followed by the same generic ending establish an ending issue, even when all three statements express the same vague message. A repeated final verb phrase is not an internal frame. A separately repeated lexical opening can coexist with an ending issue. Distinct input cases, outcomes and stages can justify identical openings; evaluate their comparison or progression independently of other slop in the passage. Documentary or criticized wording supplies context to examine rather than an adopted frame.

## Hits

# Triple Word Repeat

Judge formulaic enumeration, despite this legacy check's name. Find one coordinated list of three or more members whose interchangeable rhetorical roles manufacture completeness.

- Cover evaluative adjectives, abstract nouns and parallel rhetorical verbs, including unseen words and lists longer than three. The members need not be literal synonyms.
- Identify a defect in packaging the list, independently of whether a claim is exaggerated, true or sufficiently explained. Generic praise alone belongs to the existing evaluation check; missing substance alone belongs to semantic thinness.
- Preserve useful distinct properties, criteria, objects and operations. Three members alone establish no defect. A useful list remains a no-hit here even if one individual claim deserves another check.
- Useful surrounding facts do not repair an independent ornamental triad. Conversely, a weak claim does not make its enumeration defective automatically.
- Judge the supplied meaning rather than membership in an adjective or noun vocabulary.
- Preserve lists reproduced for analysis, correction or documentation. Assess adopted quotations and ordinary dialogue by the same contribution test.

Require one coordinated enumeration, such as members sharing a clause or an actual list structure. Three separate promotional sentences are fragment or frame material, not this list check. Do not convert nearby action narration or an inherited-fragment stack into a coordinated triad. Preserve distinct operations with different objects or effects. # Word Repetition

Find avoidable lexical echo from at least six uses of one content word in one prose paragraph. Count establishes eligibility; the contribution of repeated naming determines the judgment.

- Combine ordinary inflections in the same sense and lexical use. Count the same noun as subject, object and noun modifier together. Combine verbal inflections including verbal -ing. Keep different senses, derived words and different noun, verb or adjective uses separate. Short content words can qualify.
- Preserve paragraph boundaries. Uses across independent paragraphs do not reach the six-use threshold together.
- Exclude recurrences whose entire defect belongs to a mechanically repeated opening, terminal predicate or connector. Require six eligible uses after that exclusion for an independent word-repetition hit.
- Useful facts and distinct actions alone do not justify repeatedly naming an established subject. A shared subject, clear reference or ordinary restructuring can reveal avoidable echo even in useful instructions.
- Preserve naming that distinguishes competing referents or parts, identifies a component in independently used instruction entries, keeps comparison labels distinct, preserves a substantive terminology contrast or supplies deliberate refrain. Procedural tone, technical vocabulary and checklist headings alone supply no exemption.
- Preserve examined or documentary wording at the same frequency. Assess adopted quotations and ordinary dialogue by the same contribution test.

Five occurrences are a no-hit for this check even if they sound repetitive. Count a noun in compound modifiers together with its other same-sense uses. Judge the repeated NAME, not whether the paragraph is useful: distinct tasks can still repeat their established component name avoidably. Ordinary instructions read together can use a clear reference; independent-entry identification must be supplied by the text. Preserve recurring command verbs when their separate parameters or conditions organize useful instructions, and preserve the names that distinguish competing compared items. Do not infer an independent naming defect solely from another check's repeated frame.

# Flat Action Cadence

Find runs of at least three complete subject-first action clauses presented as equally detached beats. Changed actors, objects and verbs can preserve the same mechanical rhythm.

- Include actor movements, bodily actions, physical scene subjects and linking scene observations. Scene-only sequences can qualify. Independent clauses joined within a sentence can participate.
- Require complete clauses with their own subjects. A bare fragment stack or subject inherited from an earlier sentence belongs to fragment stacking.
- Judge the repeated presentation of the sequence. Distinct actions or concrete plot information do not by themselves supply varied emphasis. Chronological order alone establishes no useful-function exemption.
- Preserve equal short beats when their order or separate emphasis serves a recoverable procedure, event reconstruction, parallel comparison or deliberate pacing effect. A fiction genre, a technical topic or the word footage alone establishes none of those functions.
- Read the complete supplied context, including adjacent paragraphs continuing the sequence. Separate records or unrelated sections establish separate sequences.
- Judge cadence rather than whether each gesture advances the plot. Preserve examined or documentary quotations; judge ordinary narration and dialogue by the same functional test.

Each coordinated clause with its own subject counts, so two sentences may supply four beats. Judge the exact action run independently of any promotional fragments or evaluative list elsewhere. Preserve separate observations that establish which event happened, explain an operational dependency, distinguish tested alternatives or trigger the observer's next decision. Equal observations can deliberately build toward a last required signal or consequence. A mere chronological setting gives no exemption; the writing must supply that function. Incidental bag-lifting, chair-moving or animation choreography can remain gratuitous beside a useful product comparison.

# Triple Word Repeat

Judge formulaic enumeration, despite this legacy check's name. Find one coordinated list of three or more members whose interchangeable rhetorical roles manufacture completeness.

- Cover evaluative adjectives, abstract nouns and parallel rhetorical verbs, including unseen words and lists longer than three. The members need not be literal synonyms.
- Identify a defect in packaging the list, independently of whether a claim is exaggerated, true or sufficiently explained. Generic praise alone belongs to the existing evaluation check; missing substance alone belongs to semantic thinness.
- Preserve useful distinct properties, criteria, objects and operations. Three members alone establish no defect. A useful list remains a no-hit here even if one individual claim deserves another check.
- Useful surrounding facts do not repair an independent ornamental triad. Conversely, a weak claim does not make its enumeration defective automatically.
- Judge the supplied meaning rather than membership in an adjective or noun vocabulary.
- Preserve lists reproduced for analysis, correction or documentation. Assess adopted quotations and ordinary dialogue by the same contribution test.

Locate the actual comma/conjunction list before assessing its meaning. Three fragments each ending in a period do not become that list. An action sequence is also a different construction. Next ask whether the members serve interchangeable generic rhetorical roles, rather than distinct jobs, physical properties or operations. One vague or exaggerated item among useful distinctions does not establish an independent list-packaging defect. A passage may contain bad fragment beats alongside a completely useful real enumeration; judge only the latter here. A review can quote a manufacturer's praise to contrast it with the reviewer's concrete experience.

types.word-repetition:
# Word Repetition

Find avoidable lexical echo from at least six uses of one content word in one prose paragraph. Count establishes eligibility; the contribution of repeated naming determines the judgment.

- Combine ordinary inflections in the same sense and lexical use. Count the same noun as subject, object and noun modifier together. Combine verbal inflections including verbal -ing. Keep different senses, derived words and different noun, verb or adjective uses separate. Short content words can qualify.
- Preserve paragraph boundaries. Uses across independent paragraphs do not reach the six-use threshold together.
- Exclude recurrences whose entire defect belongs to a mechanically repeated opening, terminal predicate or connector. Require six eligible uses after that exclusion for an independent word-repetition hit.
- Useful facts and distinct actions alone do not justify repeatedly naming an established subject. A shared subject, clear reference or ordinary restructuring can reveal avoidable echo even in useful instructions.
- Preserve naming that distinguishes competing referents or parts, identifies a component in independently used instruction entries, keeps comparison labels distinct, preserves a substantive terminology contrast or supplies deliberate refrain. Procedural tone, technical vocabulary and checklist headings alone supply no exemption.
- Preserve examined or documentary wording at the same frequency. Assess adopted quotations and ordinary dialogue by the same contribution test.

Five occurrences are a no-hit for this check even if they sound repetitive. Count a noun in compound modifiers together with its other same-sense uses. Judge the repeated NAME, not whether the paragraph is useful: distinct tasks can still repeat their established component name avoidably. Ordinary instructions read together can use a clear reference; independent-entry identification must be supplied by the text. Preserve recurring command verbs when their separate parameters or conditions organize useful instructions, and preserve the names that distinguish competing compared items. Do not infer an independent naming defect solely from another check's repeated frame.

flat-action-cadence.instructions: Apply state.instructions and the named rulebook in state.types. Are three or more complete subject-first action clauses presented as detached equal beats without a supplied functional reason? Count coordinated clauses separately and disregard unrelated fragment or list defects.

criteria.true: At least three complete own-subject clauses mechanically enumerate actions or scene beats at equal emphasis. They can share sentences. Useful information elsewhere leaves an independent irrelevant motion sequence eligible.
criteria.false: The complete-clause run is absent, the clauses are fragments or list members, or their equal beats usefully establish an operational dependency, event reconstruction, comparison, timed observation, escalating discovery or suspense condition in the complete passage.

formal-transition-density.instructions: Apply state.instructions and the named rulebook in state.types. Do at least three nearby prefacing markers repeatedly announce relations or importance without useful organization?

criteria.true: A connected run of at least three prefacing markers stages redundant relations or significance that the adopted statements do not develop. Their repeated announcements supply no useful organization.
criteria.false: The eligible run is absent, the wording is being documented or criticized, or the markers supply meaningful addition, contrast, consequence, alternative, comparison, sequence or concurrent development in the linked statements, even if other writing is sloppy.

fragment-stacking.instructions: Apply state.instructions and the named rulebook in state.types. Does the writer adopt an eligible stack of adjacent sentence-like FRAGMENTS as gratuitous prose beats, rather than complete clauses, an in-clause enumeration or actual records, labels or answers?

criteria.true: A stated fragment form reaches its count and needlessly chops adopted ordinary prose into sentence-like beats. Inherited subjects or infinitive predicates can link an anchor to two continuations, and useful facts alone do not repair their presentation.
criteria.false: The counted pieces are complete own-subject clauses or complete commands; only one coordinated enumeration occurs inside a clause; no eligible count exists; the wording is examined; or the pieces are actual task labels, records, explicit answers or purposeful perceptual pacing.

repeated-predicate-end.instructions: Apply state.instructions and the named rulebook in state.types. Do at least three statements repeat the SAME FINAL VERB PHRASE as generic commentary, rather than useful distinct outcomes, duties or findings?

criteria.true: At least three adopted statements repeat the same final verbal wording, allowing ordinary inflections, and that ending merely supplies a generic rhetorical beat. Its recurrence serves no useful comparison, finding, instruction organization or refrain.
criteria.false: The actual final words differ or the count is below three; only openings or inner phrases repeat; the writer documents or critiques the wording; or the equal endings report independently meaningful results, tested conditions, duties or deliberate refrain.

sentence-frame-repetition.instructions: Apply state.instructions and the named rulebook in state.types. Do three statements repeat actual opening words, a distinctive first word, or an inner phrase with words AFTER it, and is that recurrence needless? Two adjacent identical explicit takeaway wrappers also qualify. Exclude repeated endings.

criteria.true: The same content-bearing opening words, distinctive first word or nonterminal inner wording recur at least three times, or the same explicit takeaway wrapper recurs in two adjacent statements. After considering useful comparison and refrain, those repeated words merely repackage the message.
criteria.false: Only the ending words recur; the common opening consists only of ordinary grammatical words; the sentence shape repeats without matching wording; no eligible count exists; the wording is examined; or the recurrence organizes distinct conditions, actions, meanings, outcomes or deliberate refrain.

triple-word-repeat.instructions: Apply state.instructions and the named rulebook in state.types. Within ONE clause or explicit list, do at least three comma/conjunction-coordinated members perform interchangeable generic rhetorical roles? Ignore trios of separate period-ended sentences or fragments.

criteria.true: All conditions hold: one actual coordinated enumeration contains at least three members; its generic praise, abstract virtues or promises manufacture completeness through interchangeable roles; and the writer adopts that independently defective packaging.
criteria.false: Any condition is absent. Separate clipped sentences or inherited continuations are other checks. Useful distinct objects, properties or operations remain a no-hit here, including lists with an individual weak claim. Reproduced marketing being criticized or evaluated is examined wording.

word-repetition.instructions: Apply state.instructions and the named rulebook in state.types. Count actual same-sense content-word uses in ONE paragraph. Are there at least SIX eligible uses, and does repeating that word itself create avoidable echo?

criteria.true: One paragraph has at least six eligible uses of one content-word lemma. Repeated naming is avoidable after the referent is established, even though the passage's facts, instructions or actions are useful. Clear reference or a shared subject preserves their meaning without that repeated naming.
criteria.false: There are at most five eligible uses, different senses or lexical uses do not separately reach six, paragraph boundaries split the count, specific-pattern ownership removes enough uses, or the repeated words themselves maintain competing referents, useful comparison labels, independent-entry identification, instructional organization or deliberate refrain.
